title: triage-pg: Temporal machine learning for public policy, end to end inside PostgreSQL.
description:
triage-pg builds temporal machine-learning pipelines for tabular public-policy data — cohort, labels, features, matrices, train, predict, evaluate — with point-in-time correctness enforced by construction. Predictions are append-only and evaluation (precision@k, recall@k, AUC, regression and survival metrics, leaderboards, audition and bias group-bys) runs as SQL inside the database, so results are queryable without leaving PostgreSQL. It runs on plain PostgreSQL with no proprietary extensions.

It is a deliberately simplified rewrite of DSSG triage, keeping that project's pipeline shape and its timechop temporal-splitting component while redesigning the substrate around a much smaller surface. The upstream team is credited in the contributors below.

contributors.name: Center for Data Science and Public Policy, University of Chicago
